description: The technical composite must use the frozen surviving component set.
Ablation ensemble predictions must contain technical composite, Elastic Net and LightGBM Ranker.
Technical composite must contain 3850 OOS predictions.
Elastic Net must contain 3850 OOS predictions.
LightGBM Ranker must contain 3850 OOS predictions.
Prediction dates must match the frozen walk-forward test dates exactly.
Predictions must be unique by fold, ticker and model.
All stored OOS predictions must be finite.
